independent_acceptance_suite.scope: Ten approved acceptance categories; written independently of implementation.

regression_demonstration_before_fixes.scope: Local run of review-regressions.test.mjs before the corresponding adapter fixes.

independent_closure.scope: Targeted verification of reported findings and their regression tests; no activation or institutional approval.

resolved_findings.issue: Conflicting legacy source could survive repository normalization.
resolved_findings.correction: Check event and wrapper source against the admitted declared producer repository; do not use source to replace missing repo.

resolved_findings.issue: Unmodeled workflow and AVOT destination selectors were silently accepted.
resolved_findings.correction: Hold non-null destination.workflow or destination.avot; preserve null as unspecified.

resolved_findings.issue: Literal lone UTF-16 surrogates could collapse distinct input strings to the same UTF-8 digest.
resolved_findings.correction: Reject literal unpaired surrogates before hashing; preserve ASCII escaped forms as byte-distinct input.

resolved_findings.issue: Null or nonobject API input could throw instead of returning a hold.
resolved_findings.correction: Return structured invalid_input hold without synthesizing provenance.

resolved_findings.issue: Caller mutation could alter a previously validated fixture observation clock.
resolved_findings.correction: Capture the validated fixed observation time when the harness is created.

resolved_findings.issue: Wrapper-only source_event could be replaced by an inappropriate legacy profile annotation.
resolved_findings.correction: Hold the unresolved declaration and leave producer source_event absent.

runner_resolution.initial_issue: Child-process launch returned EPERM in this workspace.
runner_resolution.correction: Use node:test.run with isolation none in the current process.
